_comment: Golden expectations for the format-agnostic brochure extractor. Each fixture is a `pdftotext -layout` dump of a real special-selection (特殊選才) admission brochure from a different university. They deliberately span four different section layouts so the extractor cannot be tuned to a single school. Values are lower bounds / sampled facts that a human reviewer would confirm; the extractor stays low-confidence.
